pages.text: $(l)Prioritize damage over defense$()—high-damage perks like $(o)Culling Strike$() and $(o)Last Breath$() outperform body blocking or stacking armor, especially past the usual level cap.$(br2)To maintain 1 HP for $(o)Last Breath$() or starvation builds:

$(li)Combine starvation with $(o)Last Stand$()$(li)$(o)Vis Innoculation$() keeps you at full health and works together with $(o)Last Breath$(), so you stay on full life$(br2)$(l)The Magicbane with Super Enchant Unbreaking$() deals tens of thousands of damage per hit.
